caption:
The best painter in town is usually not the one that’s booked.

A homeowner can’t judge your work before you start. They’ve never seen a wall you painted. They’re not comparing craftsmanship — they have no way to.

They’re comparing photos. That’s the whole decision.

Try this in two minutes: search "painters near me" in your city, open the top five, and count how many posted a finished job this month. That’s who’s booked. Not the best one. The visible one.

That’s the part we run. The jobs you already finish become the proof that books the next one. You keep painting.

Comment your city and I'll check how you show up — where you land, who's above you, and what they're doing that you're not. No charge, no call.

Follow @davis.mkt for more ways to fill your calendar.
